title: Same path, different: a mechanistic comparison of looped and stacked transformer encoders on 12-lead ECG
abstract: arXiv:2609.15498v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurrent Transformers reusing their weights rather than stacking $L$ distinct layers are becoming widely adopted due to their parameter efficiency [1,2,3]. However, the exact representational and dynamical differences between looped and stacked architectures remain uncharacterized. This paper presents a controlled study on the example of bViT model [1] applying one weight-tied block $L$ times. We train two models: bViT and standard ViT [4] on 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) classification tasks from the PTB-XL dataset under identical training protocols. Despite an $8.9\times$ parameter reduction, bViT achieves accuracy parity with ViT. Geometric similarity metrics demonstrate that both architectures construct comparable latent representations in an equivalent canonical order. translated_title: 相同的路径，不同的表现：循环式与堆叠式Transformer编码器在12导联心电图上的机制比较
translated_abstract: 递归Transformer通过复用权重而非堆叠L个不同层，因其参数效率正被广泛采用[1,2,3]。然而，循环结构与堆叠架构之间在表征和动力学上的确切差异仍未被刻画。本文以bViT模型[1]为例——即将一个权重绑定的模块应用L次——开展了一项受控研究。我们在PTB-XL数据集的12导联心电图（ECG）分类任务上，以完全相同的训练协议训练了两个模型：bViT和标准ViT[4]。尽管参数减少了8.9倍，bViT仍达到了与ViT相当的准确率。几何相似性度量表明，两种架构以等效的规范顺序构建了可比较的潜在表征。至关重要的是，二者的动力学行为存在差异：bViT表现出更小的步长和患者间敏感性，并且在远离数据流形处呈现近似中性的行为。
tldr: 本研究通过在12导联心电图分类任务上的受控比较发现，权重循环复用的bViT在参数减少8.9倍的情况下仍能达到与标准ViT相当的准确率，且两者构建了相似的潜在表征，但其内部动力学存在本质差异——bViT步长更小、对患者间差异更敏感，并在数据流形外表现出近乎中性的行为。
en_tdlr: This controlled study shows that a weight-tied looped transformer (bViT) matches standard ViT accuracy on 12-lead ECG classification with 8.9× fewer parameters and comparable latent representations, yet exhibits fundamentally different dynamics—smaller step sizes, greater inter-patient sensitivity, and near-neutral behavior off the data manifold.
